title: Blocks: keep pricing and summary apart; phone optional; consent wording
recommendation: Keep pricing and summary as separate blocks (U17 renames summary, U19 drops the three-tier chip); make phone optional for new forms; change the consent line to plain words that keep its legal effect, pending William's check with whoever wrote the current one.

questions.q: Keep pricing and summary as two blocks?
Phone optional for new forms (existing forms keep required)?
questions.recommended: Yes. The email is what the view notification and the lead row need; a phone can be asked for on the call.

questions.q: Compliance: is "I agree to be contacted by email or text about this proposal." enough for the texting the GoHighLevel sync enables, or must the transactional-messages wording stay?
questions.recommended: Use the new line unless the person who wrote the current one says texting rules need the old phrasing. That is a check, not a design choice.
